name: Möller-Trumbore Ray-Triangle Intersection
aliases: SDF Triangle Distance and Ray Intersection
definition: A clean algorithm for determining whether a ray intersects a triangle that translates the origin of the ray and then changes the base of that vector which yields a vector (t u v)T, where t is the distance to the plane in which the triangle lies and (u, v) represents the coordinates inside the triangle.
summary: The Möller-Trumbore algorithm computes ray-triangle intersections using barycentric coordinates and Cramer's rule, avoiding plane equations for minimal memory overhead and maximum speed.
